environment.description: Same Spring Boot 2.7.x application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate. The ALB has a listener rule with a source-IP condition that restricts inbound traffic to three CIDR blocks: 10.200.0.0/16 (internal VPC peering from the frontend cluster), 172.20.0.0/14 (corporate egress NAT pool), and 198.51.100.0/24 (partner VPN termination). These are configured as ALB listener rule conditions (not security groups) with priority 1, and a default rule that returns HTTP 403 with a fixed response body. The ALB access logs confirm no requests from outside these ranges have reached the target group in 90 days. Additionally, the ECS task role has no public IP assignment (awsvpcConfiguration.assignPublicIp=DISABLED) and the subnet route table has no internet gateway route — all egress goes through a NAT gateway with restrictive outbound security group rules (only port 443 to idp.acme.com resolved IPs).

config.load_balancer: ALB with listener rule priority 1: source-ip condition [10.200.0.0/16, 172.20.0.0/14, 198.51.100.0/24] -> forward to target group; default rule -> fixed-response 403
config.security_group_inbound: ALB security group only from known CIDRs
